digest.component_or_area: bug lifecycle — close transition with culprit linking
propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit commit resolved via git blame and rebar-ticket trailer, if a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines across file_impact point to one commit carrying a resolvable ticket ref; otherwise return None.
The --caused-by <id> CLI parameter overrides auto-derivation and always sets the caused_by link on bug close, regardless of blame state.

The auto-derived or explicit caused_by link is written via _write_link_event directly (bypassing closed-source and cycle guards) after the bug is transitioned to closed, because link addition from a closed source is normally rejected.
Auto-derivation blames the pre-fix state (fixing-commit~1), not HEAD, to avoid self-attribution; if no fixing commit is found (fix not yet committed), auto-derivation is skipped.
The caused_by link carries no confidence field and is treated as classified-confidence evidence by consuming provenance metrics, not as an authoritative structural fact.
